ADANIENT.attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited ( ACX ), a joint venture of the Company.
ADANIENT.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited confirms the completion of the acquisition of a 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited, a joint venture of the Company. This transaction was executed under a share purchase agreement with Adani Infra India Limited, the seller. The completion follows the earlier intimation dated November 6, 2026. With this acquisition, Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited has become a joint venture of Adani Enterprises Limited. The details of the acquisition were previously furnished pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

FEDERALBNK.attchmntText: The Federal Bank  Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
FEDERALBNK.voiceSummary: The Federal Bank Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding the schedule of an analyst and institutional investor meeting. Representatives of the bank will meet a group of analysts and investors physically on November 11, 2026. This intimation is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The schedule is subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances involving the bank or participating attendees. Any updates or revisions will be promptly communicated to the exchanges. The notice was issued by Samir P Rajdev, Company Secretary, on November 08, 2026.

MPHASIS.attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 152891  Shares.
MPHASIS.voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited intimates that its ESOP Compensation Committee approved the allotment of 1,52,891 equity shares on 8 November 2026. This allotment is against the exercise of Employee Stock Options and Restricted Stock Units. Specifically, 15,500 shares were allotted under the Employee Stock Options Plan 2016. Additionally, 1,37,391 shares were allotted under the Restricted Stock Units Plan 2021. For employees exercising options under the Cashless Scheme, the Mphasis Employees Equity Reward Trust will deduct shares to cover exercise prices and taxes. These proceeds will repay loans from the company. Similarly, the Mphasis Employees Benefit Trust will deduct shares for the RSU Plan 2021 to cover costs and taxes. The terms of exercise follow the respective plans already submitted to stock exchanges.

ALKEM.attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of incorporation of subsidiary in the form of Joint Venture.
ALKEM.voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited incorporated a subsidiary named Alkem Pharma Company, Limited Liability Company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on 8th November, 2026. This entity operates as a Joint Venture in the pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals industry. The company holds a 51% stake in the subsidiary. The total capital of the new entity is 7,500,000.0 SAR, divided into 75,000.0 shares of 100 SAR each. Alkem Laboratories subscribed to 38,250 shares, amounting to 3,825,000.00 SAR. The investment is a strategic move to expand business and market reach in Saudi Arabia. The subsidiary will handle the manufacture, import, marketing, and distribution of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. The transaction is not a related party transaction. No promoter group has an interest in the entity.

COROMANDEL.attchmntText: Coromandel International Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
COROMANDEL.voiceSummary: Coromandel International Limited has announced a conference call to discuss financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The event is organized by Systematix Institutional Equities and scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. Management representatives include Mr. Sankarasubramanian S., MD and CEO, and Mr. Deepak Natarajan, CFO. Audio recordings and transcripts will be available on the company website at www.coromandel.biz.

ASTERDM.attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026
ASTERDM.voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Andhra Jyothi on 7 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a net profit after tax of 7,645.00 lakhs. The basic earnings per share was 6.75. Total income from operations stood at 17,036.11 lakhs. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, net profit after tax was 4,149.00 lakhs with basic earnings per share of 4.97. Total income from operations was 8,306.25 lakhs. The paid-up equity share capital is 11,625.89 lakhs. The net worth is 1,78,213.72 lakhs. The debt equity ratio is 0.78.

AIIL.attchmntText: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corporate Presentation for November 2026'.
AIIL.voiceSummary: Authum Investment and Infrastructure Limited filed a business update and corporate presentation for November 2026 with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The presentation outlines the company's investment strategy across flow investments, strategic investments, and its ARC platform ISARC. As of September 30, 2026, the investment book size is Rs. 13,568.9 Cr, with Rs. 8,779.0 Cr in strategic investments. The company reported total profit booked of Rs. 155.7 Cr from exits during FY26 and Rs. 1,512.0 Cr from exits in H1 FY27. Cumulative unrealized profits on existing investments stand at Rs. 2,869 Cr. Key strategic holdings include Prataap Snacks and NITCO Ltd.

GLAXO.attchmntText: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
GLAXO.voiceSummary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited uploaded the transcript link for its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call to its website. The call, held on November 04, 2026, featured Managing Director Bhushan Akshikar and Chief Financial Officer Ronojit Biswas. Revenues for the quarter ended September increased 21% year-on-year to INR1,180 crores, marking the highest quarterly sales recorded. EBITDA stood at INR400 crores, growing 20%, with margins maintained at 34%. The innovation portfolio contributed 7% of overall revenues, up from 3% in the same quarter last year. Management noted volume growth and highlighted performance in general medicines, paediatric vaccines, and specialty segments including oncology and adult vaccines. Input cost pressures due to rupee appreciation and oil-linked inflation were acknowledged, with plans to use competitive price increases to manage costs.

TATACHEM.attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
TATACHEM.voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting on November 7, 2026. The results were published in newspapers on November 8, 2026. Consolidated revenue from continuing operations was 4,177 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 8,432 crore for the half-year. Consolidated loss after tax was 50 crore for the quarter and 10 crore for the half-year. Standalone revenue from continuing operations was 1,303 crore for the quarter and 2,584 crore for the half-year. Standalone profit after tax was 122 crore for the quarter and 465 crore for the half-year. Consolidated earnings per share were negative 4.79 for the quarter and negative 5.46 for the half-year. Standalone earnings per share were 4.79 for the quarter and 18.25 for the half-year.

ARE&M.attchmntText: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
ARE&M.voiceSummary: Amara Raja Energy and Mobility Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR4,108 crores. Lead-acid business revenue grew by 18%, while new energy business revenue reached INR232 crores, growing over 30%. Standalone EBITDA margin was 10.1%. Consolidated margin decreased by 1.3% to 8.8%. The board approved a wholly owned subsidiary for Amaron Assist and a new phase of investment in prismatic cell gigafactory with a capex of INR2,320 crores. The company expects to spend INR2,200 crores on capex in FY27.

JUBLINGREA.attchmntText: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
JUBLINGREA.voiceSummary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, via its wholly owned subsidiary Jubilant Advanced Electronics Limited, has executed a Share Subscription and Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 40% strategic equity stake in Zettaone Technologies India Private Limited. The transaction includes an option to increase shareholding to 51% during the next year, subject to terms and conditions. This move allows the company to enter the Electronics Design and Manufacturing Services sector. The investment aims to serve customers in semiconductors, aerospace, defense, and automotive segments. It also supports the company's semiconductor and electronics chemicals vertical by combining manufacturing excellence with new capabilities. Key terms were previously disclosed in a letter dated October 1, 2026. The information is available on the company website.

NEOGEN.attchmntText: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
NEOGEN.voiceSummary: Neogen Chemicals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on November 2, 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 42% year-on-year to INR 296 crore, with EBITDA improving by 51% to INR 45 crore. Standalone PAT surged 127% to INR 21 crore. The company completed a Qualified Institutional Placement raising INR 600 crore. Insurance claim recoveries total INR 316 crore, including an accepted additional claim of INR 152 crore. The Board approved expanding Organolithium capacity at Patancheru from 300 to 600 metric tonnes per annum with an outlay of up to INR 45 crore. Neogen Ionics Limited executed a business transfer agreement for lithium-ion electrolyte salt operations to Neogen Morita New Materials Limited for INR 245 crore. CRISIL upgraded the long-term bank facility outlook to stable. Net debt stood at INR 1,095 crore on a consolidated basis as of September 30, 2026.

NEOGEN.attchmntText: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Fire Incident - Order for Revocation of earlier Directions issued by GPCB and granting of CC&A Amendment by GPCB.
NEOGEN.voiceSummary: Neogen Chemicals Limited received a Revocation of Direction order from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board on November 7, 2026. This order revokes previous directives issued after the March 5, 2025 fire incident at the Dahej SEZ Multi-Purpose Plant 3 facility. The Board also granted a provisional consent order, designated CC&A amendment AWH-163560, valid until March 19, 2030. The earlier direction had imposed an Environment Damage Compensation cost of Rs. 34.60 lakhs and required a Bank Guarantee of Rs. 7.5 Lakhs. Production at the affected plant was suspended, but the company has installed a new replacement MPP-5 plant which is currently in trial production. The revocation is subject to compliance with the submitted undertaking dated September 1, 2026, and the conditions of the new consent order.

SURYAROSNI.attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
SURYAROSNI.voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of a newspaper advertisement on 8th November 2026. The advertisement discloses the extract of Unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 7th November 2026. The advertisement was published in Economic Times English Edition in New Delhi and Mumbai, Dainik Tribune Hindi Edition in Chandigarh, and Economic Times English in all editions. The information is also available on the company website at www.surya.co.in.
